steps.clue: Repair the ziplines and complete two of the Hermit’s challenge totems.
Place the Hermit’s dials in Artifact Storage and collect the three Apothicon offerings.
Follow the Apothicon’s clue and blast open the safe containing the Seal of Duality.
Return the three blood orbs and purify the Seal with Samantha’s Music Box.
Charge the Fire and Ice Soapstones and use them to obtain the fuse.
Power the Lighthouse Station door and recover the Elemental Shard.
Use the Elemental Shard and repeat the blood-orb purification ritual.
Give the Seal to the Hermit and survive the Lighthouse lockdown.
Charge the Seal at the four Pack-a-Punch machines and purify it again.
Charge the Agarthan Device at Golden Pack-a-Punch and escort it through the collapsing map.
Return the Agarthan Device to the Hermit, then retrieve it at the Forecastle.
